# Working of Recursion

#### Course: Learn Recursion With Java

## Working of Recursion

Here's a step-by-step breakdown of the method calls and print values.

![Each Recursive Call Prints the Number Until Base Case is Reached](data:image/png;base64,)

The printNumbers() method calls itself until n equals 3.

When n equals 3, the base case is reached and the recursive calls are terminated by the return statement.

Here, the printNumbers() method doesn't return any value. Next, we will learn to return values from recursive methods.
